review_scope.method: Compared each frozen source snapshot with its matching local HTML preview; visually inspected every receipt-listed PNG tile individually at original resolution.
review_scope.source_html_and_tile_hashes: Verified against assignment and capture receipts; all matched.
review_scope.diagram_scope: No authored TikZ or diagram markup in assigned snapshots. Reviewed mathematical content for missing high-likelihood diagrams; none warranted.
review_scope.limitations: Local preview audit only; no production website, network, or live application route was accessed.
review_scope.attestation: The assigned reviewer opened every listed image using tools.view_image at original resolution and inspected the visible rendered content.
